title: Heading to New Orleans and marrying Hazel Robinson
summary: After discharge White went to New Orleans, where he married Hazel Robinson in 1920.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: By the way, Lizzie's coming out here to Monterey and I guess next month. Is she?

I'll be down there. I'll be down there. Now, during my stay down in New Orleans, I got married after I... Came back here. I got married in 1920 to a girl named Hazel Robinson in New Orleans. She was a beautician and a very fine person. And I happened to be living right in the same block on Murray Street. Where her mother had a cafe at the corner. And Hazel and I struck up a friendship because I was doing her printing. And I got mustered out of the service. I, instead of looking for music to play or trooping any longer, I went to work in my trade. But I had almost forgotten that I was a printer.
